theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  classical
  have h1 : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra h
    have hA : A ∉ P := fun hA => h (Or.inl hA)
    have hAc : Aᶜ ∉ P := fun hAc => h (Or.inr hAc)
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      have : ¬(∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h_all
        have : ∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := ⟨A, hA, h_all⟩
        contradiction
      simpa using this
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ : ∃ V ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
      have : ¬(∀ U ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h_all
        have : ∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := ⟨Aᶜ, hAc, h_all⟩
        contradiction
      simpa using this
    have hU_sub : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxA
      have : x ∈ A := by simpa [Set.mem_compl] using hxA
      have : x ∈ A ∩ U := by exact ⟨hxA, hx⟩
      contradiction
    have hV_sub : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxA
      have : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa [Set.mem_compl] using hxA
      have : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := by exact ⟨hxA, hx⟩
      contradiction
    have hUV : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    have hUV_empty : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      intro x hx
      have : x ∈ U := by exact hx.1
      have : x ∈ V := by exact hx.2
      have : x ∈ Aᶜ := hU_sub this.1
      have : x ∈ A := hV_sub this.2
      contradiction
    exact hUV hUV_empty
  have h2 : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    contradiction
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \\ P
  have h3 : Q.card = P.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hA
      have : A ∉ P := hA.1
      have : Aᶜ ∈ P := by
        cases h1 A with hA' hAc
        · contradiction
        · exact hAc
      exact this
    · intro A hA
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      simp
      intro x hx
      have : x ∈ A ∩ Aᶜ := by exact ⟨hx, hx⟩
      contradiction
    · intro A hA hB hAB; rw [hAB]
    · intro A hA; ext x; simp
    · intro A hA; ext x; simp
  have h4 : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_add_inter_disjoint P Q]
      · simp [Q]
      · exact Finset.disjoint_sdiff_left P Finset.univ
    rw [this]
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  have h5 : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [h3] at h4; omega
  have h6 : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
  have h7 : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    · omega
    · omega
  rw [← h7] at h5
  omega
